verdict.rationale: BigQuery sharing (formerly Analytics Hub) is explicitly documented as a data exchange platform that lets you securely share, discover, and access data across organizational boundaries without replicating data, including monetizable listings via Google Cloud Marketplace. This directly matches the story of sharing live datasets cross-account/org without copying or building export pipelines. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of the sharing/Analytics Hub feature specifically (community evidence in the pack is about pricing/performance, not sharing).
